chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Isma'il from Hanan from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
It is permissible to take the pebbles of the Jamaraat from all of the Haram (sanctuary), except from Masjid al-Haram and Masjid al-Khayf.

key_terms.مَسْجِدُ الْحَرَامِ: Masjid al-Haram (the Grand Mosque in Mecca)

ai.seo_question: Where can one collect the pebbles for throwing at the Jamarat during Hajj?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the permissibility of collecting pebbles for Rami al-Jamarat from the entire Haram precincts, excluding only the specific sanctities of Masjid al-Haram and Masjid al-Khayf. This ruling underscores the flexibility in Hajj rituals while maintaining respect for the holiest sites, a detail preserved in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* to guide jurists in distinguishing between general sacred space and specific prohibited zones for resource collection.
